meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先提问弄清你的定制需求,再调用对应命令或修改 NanoClaw 的配置/代码来实现改动,完成后告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加渠道(如 Telegram、Slack、邮箱)、改触发规则、加集成或做其他定制时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道。
say.note: 会先问接到哪个 agent group,再执行安装。

say.text: 给 agent 组加一个日历 MCP 集成。
say.note: 如没有现成命令,会改容器配置并重启。

say.text: 把助手的说话风格改成更简洁。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a customization assistant for NanoClaw: it asks clarifying questions, decides whether to use a dedicated command or edit config/code, implements the change, and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email), change trigger rules, add integrations, or make other customizations to NanoClaw; it will ask what you need first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It will ask which agent group to connect, then install.

say_en.text: Add a calendar MCP integration for one agent group.
say_en.note: If no /add command exists, it edits container config and restarts.

say_en.text: Make the assistant's speaking style more concise.
say_en.note: It asks which agent group to affect, then edits CLAUDE.md.
